info.name: API V1 API Partners Repair Orders API
Get a list of all repair orders

params.name: shop_id
params.description: Filter response to include only Repair Orders with this Shop ID.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Filter response to include only Customer with this ID.

params.name: vehicle_id
params.description: Filter response to include only Vehicle with this ID.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter response to include only Repair Orders with the provided status: One of 'estimate', 'in_progress', or 'invoice'.

params.name: number
params.description: Filter response to include only Repair Orders with this RO number.

params.name: closed_after
params.description: Filter response to include only Repair Orders having been closed (status = invoice) after the provided datetime.

params.name: technician_id
params.description: Filter response to only include Repair Orders assigned to this Technican ID.

params.name: associations[]
params.description: An optional list that controls what nested associations are included in the response.         Currently supported values are 'none', 'payments', 'integrator_tags', 'label', 'financials',         'services', 'services.labors', 'services.parts', 'services.hazmats', 'services.inspections', 'services.sublets'         'customer', 'customer.phones', 'customer.integrator_tags'         'vehicle', 'vehicle.integrator_tags.         Note that if you specify a deeply nested association e.g. 'services.hazmats', then 'services' is implied, so it's not necessary to provide 'services,services.hazmats'.         Example: /api/v1/tenants/<tenant id>/repair_orders?associations[]=customer&associations[]=services.inspections&associations[]=vehicle.integrator_tags

params.name: updated_after
params.description: Filter response to only include records updated after a given time

items.docs: Get a list of all repair orders
